description: IndoStar Capital Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financing services in India. The company offers vehicle finance products for new and used commercial vehicles, including medium and heavy commercial vehicles, light commercial vehicles, intermediate commercial vehicles, small commercial vehicles, pick-ups, and buses; new and used passenger vehicles; new and used construction equipment; and new and used farm equipment. It also distributes life, motor, and health insurance products. In addition, the company provides micro loans against property (LAP)/small ticket business loans for business expansion, working capital, higher education, medical emergency, child's marriage, medical expenses, and consolidation of obligations applications. The company serves transport entrepreneurs, self-employed professionals, agricultural equipment users, truck operators, salaried professionals, small and medium enterprise (SME) businesses, and other customers. It sells its products through its branches. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Mumbai, India. IndoStar Capital Finance Limited operates as a subsidiary of BCP V Multiple Holdings Pte. Ltd.
